question.question: In the commentary accompanying recommendation 7 (B3-1) of this PDF, which pair correctly states BOTH examples of inadequate intake indicating medical nutrition, including their duration qualifiers?

options.A: Less than 50% of requirements for more than one week, or only 50-75% of requirements for more than two weeks.
options.B: Less than 50% of requirements for more than one day, or only 50-75% for more than two days.
options.C: Less than 75% of requirements for more than one week, or 75-100% for more than two weeks.
options.D: Exactly 50% of requirements for exactly one week, or exactly 75% for exactly two weeks; no range or longer-duration condition is given.
